{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99 (without commas)
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
len(test_orders), test_orders[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean', 'status']].head()"}
